Extract text direction from lang attribute on html element

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<html lang="en" dir="ltr"><head><title>LTR Document</title></head><body><p>This is left-to-right text.</p></body></html>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
